title: subtube device file, version 1
description: One device's channel filters and watched marks, kept as device-<deviceId>.json in the user's Google Drive app folder (<deviceId> matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$). Each device writes only its own file and reads every device's file. This schema says what a writer must write. Readers are more forgiving (shared/fixtures/merge.json) and must keep fields they don't know: an object read from a file and written back, or a filter edited and saved, keeps every unknown field unchanged, so a newer client's additions survive an older client's saves. Adding an optional field keeps version 1; any change an older reader would misread bumps `version`, and a reader skips files whose version it doesn't know.

version.description: Format version. Readers skip a file whose version they don't know.

channels.description: The last filter this device saved for each channel, keyed by YouTube channel id (UC…).

watched.description: The last watched mark this device made for each video or playlist, keyed by its YouTube id. Marks older than a year are dropped when the device writes (shared/fixtures/prune.json).

at.description: When the entry was saved, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).
When the entry was saved, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

watched.description: Whether the item is marked watched; false is an explicit unmark.

filter.description: A channel's filter (shared/fixtures/filters.json). The channel's identity (id, title, thumbnail) belongs to YouTube and is never stored here. A reader treats a missing field, or one holding a value it doesn't recognize, as the field's default.

enabled.description: Whether the main feed loads this channel. Default true.

regex.description: Filter pattern in the shared pattern language (shared/patterns/README.md); "" means no pattern. Default "". The pattern below is shared/patterns/meta-regex.txt.

mode.description: include keeps items the pattern finds; exclude drops them. Default include.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the pattern matches ASCII letters case-sensitively. Default false.

searchScope.description: What the pattern is searched in; both searches title and description separately. Default title.

minDurationSeconds.description: Drop videos shorter than this many seconds; 0 keeps every length. Default 0.

liveFilter.description: Which broadcast kinds to keep: all (everything but upcoming), vod (live streams and their replays), normal (plain uploads). Default all.

shortsFilter.description: Which videos to keep: all, normal (no Shorts) or shorts (only Shorts). Default all.

contentMode.description: Whether the channel contributes its uploads or its playlists. Default videos.

followed.description: Added in subtube rather than subscribed to on YouTube; listed while true. Default false.
